items.text: Shows the breaker being switched off on camera before touching any wires.
Holds the voltage tester to each wire on camera so its reading or light shows the power is off.
Holds each wire to the camera and connects it to the right terminal: brown (or old red) to L, blue (or old black) to N.
Connects the green-and-yellow earth wire to the earth terminal (E). On older installs, the bare earth wire is covered in green-and-yellow sleeving.
Tightens every terminal screw and gives each wire a light pull to show it is firm. No bare copper shows outside the terminals.
Fixes the faceplate to the box straight and level, with no wires trapped.
Switches the power back on and shows the socket works, with a socket tester or a plugged-in device.
